baseline_models.focus_anchor: The chain at focus words 2, 5, 7-11 moves from imparting, to a written composition, to truth, and then to active confirmation of what stands before it.
baseline_models.mechanism: A privately delivered communication becomes a durable textual object whose reality is not isolated: its truth operates relationally by testing and affirming material already or immediately before it.

activation_trace.role: A concealed imparting of knowledge supplies the message's directed mode of arrival.
An ordered written composition supplies the durable object whose contents can be compared.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the emphatic predicate's claim.
Truthful correspondence supplies the active participle's verifying relation to another witness.
An interval between parties locates the confirmed material relationally rather than treating it as detached.
What stands in front or near supplies the idiom's spatial-temporal orientation.

changed_reading.before: A revealed book is simply declared true.
changed_reading.after: A directed communication takes durable textual form and demonstrates its truth through an active relation of verification with what already stands before it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 5, 7, and 8 can be read through the decree, binding-due, and fulfillment branches of their roots.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Book can function as an enacted determination, truth as what has become binding, and confirmation as making a prior word or promise effective. This yields a juridical-performative reading alongside the correspondence reading.

activation_trace.role: A recorded determination that imposes judgment or measure makes the Book an operative order, not only a document.
A fixed obligation or due supplies truth with binding force.
Making a promise, vision, or statement come true supplies confirmation with performative force.

changed_reading.after: Confirmation can also mean that the communicated decree makes an already binding claim or promise real in action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction at focus words 10-11 literally orients the object of confirmation in front of, near, or prior to the Book.
baseline_models.mechanism: The spatial idiom leaves two temporal directions live: preceding material can stand before the new message in sequence, while an impending reality can stand before it as what is near to occur. Confirmation is therefore potentially retrospective and prospective.

activation_trace.role: The middle or interval preserves a relational field rather than fixing one temporal direction.
Frontness, precedence, and nearness keep both prior witness and impending event available.
Realization of a promise or vision permits confirmation to point toward fulfillment as well as backward agreement.

changed_reading.before: What is before the Book denotes only earlier texts.
changed_reading.after: The Book may face both inherited witness behind it and promised reality approaching before it, confirming across both directions.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final construction at focus words 14-16 places the servants under paired divine expertise and sight.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge of inward circumstances and direct sight of outward conditions jointly underwrite the truth claim. The close is an epistemic warrant calibrated to persons, motives, and visible acts, not an ornamental pair of titles.

activation_trace.role: Submissive service supplies the human relation whose hidden fidelity and visible conduct are assessed.
Knowledge gained at the inward depth of a matter supplies access beyond appearance.
Direct visual perception supplies witness of exposed conditions and acts.
Penetrating discernment joins physical sight to informed judgment of the servants.

changed_reading.before: The closing titles merely generalize divine omniscience.
changed_reading.after: The closing pair warrants the revelation by encompassing both the servants' concealed interiors and their inspectable conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier assertion that God's promise is binding truth, framed against deception that gleams without holding, gives the focus truth a future edge. What stands before the Book can include an outcome not yet realized but already due.

activation_trace.role: Binding necessity lets the focus truth carry an obligation whose fulfillment may still be ahead.
What is in front or near provides the focus anchor for prospective confirmation.
A spoken promise that opens expectation supplies the not-yet-realized object of truth.
The context explicitly couples promise with binding truth, transferring futurity into the focus predicate.
Deceptive shine without stability provides the foil that distinguishes durable promise from attractive appearance.

structural_cues: The same truth lexeme predicates a promise in 35:5 before predicating the revealed Book in 35:31.
The front-facing idiom in the focus does not grammatically force a past-only referent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a promise named truth, a deception contrast, and a front-facing focus idiom. I infer that promised fulfillment can be among what the Book verifies ahead of itself. A live alternative is that the idiom refers only to prior written revelation.

changed_reading.before: The Book confirms only an inherited textual past.
changed_reading.after: The Book also confirms a promised future: what is not yet visible can already stand before it as a binding truth rather than a deceptive prospect.

context_deltas.mechanism: A person can visually register an embellished evil as good, while the later context locates divine knowledge in the unseen and in the action-producing interior. The focus pairing of inward expertise and sight therefore names correction of mis-seeing, not redundant observation.

activation_trace.role: Inward expertise supplies access to the concealed condition that surface vision can miss.
Penetrating discernment supplies corrected judgment rather than bare optical registration.
Making something appear good supplies the mechanism by which a visible surface can mislead.
Eye or inner seeing supplies the human judgment that accepts the embellished surface.
The good-versus-ugly contrast supplies the mistaken value assigned by the viewer.
What is hidden from eyes supplies the domain that optical appearance cannot settle.
The inward source from which actions issue supplies the concealed origin known by divine expertise.

structural_cues: In 35:8 seeing and moral evaluation diverge: evil is seen as good.
In 35:38 unseen knowledge narrows to what is within breasts, after the focus has paired expertise with sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fallible human seeing, concealed interiors, and the focus's paired titles. I infer a corrective division of labor: expertise reaches the source while sight registers manifestation. A live alternative is that both titles simply intensify undifferentiated omniscience.

changed_reading.before: Divine sight means perfect observation of the same surfaces humans see.
changed_reading.after: The paired close exposes the insufficiency of surface vision: God sees the act while knowing the hidden production of the appearance and thus cannot be deceived by moral decoration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The good word rises in company with fitting work, and the later sequence turns recitation of the Book into prayer, expenditure, and full payment. This makes confirmation an enacted correspondence in which conduct carries a word into realized truth.

activation_trace.role: Fulfillment by deed supplies the focus participle with an enactment sense beyond verbal assent.
Meaningful speech linking speakers supplies the verbal element awaiting embodied verification.
Purposive action supplies the practical counterpart through which the good word becomes effective.
Elevation supplies the directional link by which speech and fitting action acquire acceptance or efficacy.
Following in sequence supplies recitation as an ongoing attachment to the Book rather than isolated utterance.
Sending wealth outward supplies the visible deed that follows recitation and prayer.
Completion without deficiency supplies the answering realization of the practiced word.

structural_cues: The subject of the raising verb in 35:10 is grammatically live, placing word and work in a deliberately tight causal relation.
The immediate 35:29-30 sequence runs from Book-recitation through embodied acts to completed recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ascending good word, fitting work, a raising verb, and recitation followed by acts and payment. I infer that work authenticates or carries the word into realization. A live alternative is that God raises the work or the word without making action the confirmer.

changed_reading.before: The Book confirms earlier words by matching their content.
changed_reading.after: The Book confirms by generating a word-to-work-to-fulfillment sequence; truth is recognized in enacted correspondence as well as textual agreement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same Book lexeme earlier contains the measured extension and reduction of lives. That recurrence allows the focus's source phrase to point not only to a bounded scripture but also to a comprehensive register or determination from which the revealed communication discloses ordered reality.

activation_trace.role: Directed imparting supplies disclosure from a source larger than the immediate utterance.
An established determination supplies the focus Book with a decree-register reading.
A register fixing life spans supplies the contextual instance that carries measured order back into the focus.

structural_cues: The same indefinite Book noun in 35:11 contains lifespan measures, while the focus says the revealed material is from the Book.
The source preposition in the focus permits a source or partitive relation without deciding it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated Book language and an earlier register of measured lives. I infer semantic carryback from register to the focus source. A live alternative is ordinary polysemy: the earlier record and the focus scripture may be distinct uses with no source relation.

changed_reading.before: The source is exclusively a previously bounded written scripture.
changed_reading.after: The revealed Book can also be heard as disclosure from a comprehensive determination in which temporal lives and realities are already inscribed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two unequal waters can remain different while each yields benefit, and previous messengers arrive through several named media of disclosure. Read as an analogy, this prevents confirmation from collapsing witnesses into sameness: distinct forms can remain distinct while participating in one truth-bearing economy.

activation_trace.role: Correspondence to truth supplies relation without requiring formal identity.
A connection maintained between parties supplies continuity across their distinction.
Equality as the explicitly negated comparison supplies a model in which shared yield does not erase difference.
Plural message-bearers supply the historical continuity of transmission.
Manifest evidence supplies one mode by which earlier messages become testable.
A distinct written-scripture medium supplies plurality within the inherited witness.
The named written composition supplies another durable medium beside signs and prior writings.
Illumination supplies the shared disclosure function across the distinct media.

structural_cues: In 35:12 the two waters are expressly unequal, yet the continuation attributes useful yield to each.
In 35:25 signs, writings, and an illuminating Book remain separately named in one messenger sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unequal yet useful waters and plural disclosure media. I infer an analogy: confirmation can preserve difference while recognizing shared truth-bearing function. A live alternative is that the water comparison concerns creation alone and should not govern textual relations.

changed_reading.before: To confirm earlier material is to reproduce or homogenize it.
changed_reading.after: Confirmation may preserve nonidentity: different witnesses and media can remain unlike while the new Book recognizes and illuminates their truthful yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier claim that no informant compares with an expert turns the focus's closing epithet into a source credential. The One who imparts the Book knows the interior of the reported matter and also directly witnesses the servants to whom it speaks.

activation_trace.role: Hidden but directed communication creates the need to establish the communicator's competence.
Knowledge of reports and inward realities supplies the source's epistemic qualification.
Direct sight supplies witness in addition to reported expertise.
A report that arrives and is conveyed supplies the explicit informational frame.
The incomparable knower of a matter's interior supplies the standard for trustworthy informing.

structural_cues: In 35:14 the expert epithet is syntactically tied to the act of informing.
The same epithet closes the focus immediately after revelation, truth, and confirmation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit expert-informant construction and repeats the expert title after the focus communication claim. I infer that the close retroactively authenticates the source. A live alternative is that it only asserts incomparable general knowledge without functioning as a provenance argument.

changed_reading.before: The final titles are a general devotional close after the truth claim.
changed_reading.after: The final titles are part of the truth mechanism: the communication is credible because its source has inward expertise and direct sight unmatched by any informant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence distinguishes blind from seeing, hearing from being made to hear, and truthful sending from actual guidance. The later arrival of a warner can even increase flight. The focus Book's truth and confirming function therefore do not mechanically determine reception.

activation_trace.role: Truth fixed against falsehood lets validity remain stable when reception fails.
Inner discernment supplies the recipient capacity that cannot be reduced to message availability.
Blindness of inner perception supplies a mode of failed uptake despite an available contrast.
Discernment supplies the contrasting receptive state.
Causing another to hear supplies the disputed efficacy that exceeds mere speaking.
The messenger and message relation supplies a valid delivery regardless of response.
Sending with stable truth directly separates message validity from audience acceptance.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the intended effect without guaranteeing that effect.
Gentle direction toward a true path supplies the guidance the audience had claimed it would accept.
Increase supplies the reversal in which arrival amplifies the opposite response.
Pulling away from the message supplies the realized response that contradicts the prior claim.

structural_cues: The contrast chain in 35:19-22 separates exposure, perception, life, and effective hearing.
In 35:42 the arrival of the requested warner produces an increase, but the increase is in aversion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a truthful sending, differentiated perceptual capacities, and a warner whose arrival increases flight. I infer that truth and confirmation do not causally compel assent. A live alternative is that these verses console the messenger without qualifying the focus's confirming action.

changed_reading.before: A truth-confirming Book should transparently produce recognition in anyone who encounters it.
changed_reading.after: The Book remains true and confirming while reception branches: the same arrival can awaken discernment or intensify aversion, so rejection does not falsify the message.

context_deltas.mechanism: The local sequence moves from servants reciting the Book, through revelation and divine scrutiny, to the Book's transfer as an inheritance among chosen servants who occupy three unequal moral positions. The focus becomes a hinge from authenticated transmission to risky, differentiated custody.

activation_trace.role: The durable written composition supplies the object capable of passing into human custody.
Servants in a relation of submissive service supply the human group addressed by divine scrutiny.
Knowledge of inward conditions allows stewardship to be assessed beneath broad group membership.
Direct sight supplies oversight of how the inherited Book is actually carried.
Following the Book in recited sequence supplies one lived mode of custody before the focus.
The recited written composition supplies the pre-focus human engagement with the same object.
Transmission of knowledge or a book as inheritance supplies the post-focus transfer into communal custody.
The same written object supplies continuity across revelation, recitation, and inheritance.
Selection of a chosen group supplies privilege without erasing variation within that group.
The repeated servants relation explicitly links the focus close to the inheriting community.
A middle position between extremes supplies one nonuniform mode of carrying the inheritance.
Advancing ahead in a race supplies the foremost mode alongside moderate and self-wronging custody.

structural_cues: The local order is reciting Book in 35:29, revealed Book in 35:31, and inherited Book in 35:32.
The servants phrase at the focus close recurs in 35:32 immediately before a threefold internal differentiation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated Book and servants expressions plus the reveal-to-inherit sequence. I infer that the focus close anticipates oversight of morally mixed stewardship. A live alternative is that the focus speaks of all servants generally and the next verse begins an independent classification.

changed_reading.before: The verse ends once the Book's external authenticity is established.
changed_reading.after: The verse is a hinge: authenticated revelation becomes an inherited trust carried unevenly by chosen servants, and the closing expertise and sight make room for that internal differentiation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later challenge asks whether rival authorities received a Book from which they stand on manifest evidence, then contrasts that absent grant with mutually circulated deceptive promises. This makes the focus Book an authorized evidentiary source whose confirming force differs from self-validating assertion.

activation_trace.role: A durable written composition supplies the document from which warranted evidence can proceed.
Establishing and displaying truth through evidence supplies the focus predicate's demonstrative force.
Correspondence between claim and reality supplies the test that authorized evidence passes.
A granted written document supplies the missing warrant demanded of rival claims.
Manifest disclosure supplies the evidentiary footing that a genuine Book could confer.
Mutual promise supplies the rival speech-act that claims a future without authoritative grounding.
Shimmering deception without stability supplies the diagnosis of the unsupported promise.

structural_cues: The later question uses a Book-to-evidence source construction and denies that grant to the rivals.
The adversative turn replaces documentary evidence with wrongdoers promising one another deception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a granted Book as possible evidentiary footing and contrasts its absence with deceptive promises. I infer that the focus Book's confirmation is authorized evidence, not circular self-assertion. A live alternative is that 35:40 only attacks rival worship and does not specify the focus Book's epistemic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The Book is true because the verse labels it true.
changed_reading.after: The Book occupies an authorized evidentiary position: it can disclose a clear footing and verify other witnesses, unlike unsupported promises that circulate only between claimants.

context_deltas.mechanism: An invariant path is followed by a command to travel, look, and inspect predecessors' outcomes. This extends what stands before the Book from earlier wording to visible historical residue: the Book confirms a recurring pattern that can be encountered in the world.

activation_trace.role: Realization in events supplies confirmation as historical fulfillment rather than only verbal agreement.
The relational space before the Book permits an encountered historical field.
What is in front and near supplies the anchor for remains and outcomes placed before observers.
A running path repeatedly followed supplies the stable historical pattern.
One thing replacing another supplies the substitution explicitly denied of the pattern.
Change from one condition to another supplies the transformation explicitly denied of the pattern.
Moving through the land supplies physical access to the historical witness.
Directing sight and insight supplies the act by which the witness is inspected.
The final consequence of a course supplies the observable result that confirms the pattern.

structural_cues: The no-substitution and no-transformation formulas are followed immediately by travel and visual inspection.
The inspected people are explicitly those from before, echoing the focus's front-prior idiom.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an invariant historical path and a command to inspect predecessors' outcomes. I infer that visible history can join earlier texts among what the Book confirms. A live alternative is that the focus object remains exclusively prior revelation and history is only later corroboration.

changed_reading.before: The object confirmed is a corpus of earlier statements.
changed_reading.after: The Book also confirms an embodied historical pattern: predecessors' outcomes stand before observers as visible realization of the truth it announces.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah-final echo repeats divine sight of the servants inside a sentence about earned acts, delayed taking, and an appointed term. That echo gives the focus sight a temporal mode: complete observation can coexist with restraint and deferred reckoning.

activation_trace.role: The servants relation supplies the repeated object of sustained divine oversight.
Direct sight supplies complete awareness without itself specifying immediate intervention.
Acquired results of action supply the conduct already visible and answerable.
A fixed limit of time supplies the interval during which observed accountability is deferred.
The repeated servants relation binds the final temporal scene back to the focus close.
The repeated sight epithet closes the delay scene with uninterrupted observation.

structural_cues: The final verse nearly repeats the focus's servants-and-sight close while omitting the expertise epithet.
The repeated phrase follows explicit non-immediate taking and delay to a named term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact thematic echo of servants and sight within delayed accountability. I infer that the focus sight is patient temporal governance, not a claim that seeing entails instant punishment. A live alternative is that the final echo merely reiterates general omniscience after an unrelated delay clause.

changed_reading.before: Being seen by God implies immediate exposure and response.
changed_reading.after: Divine sight is continuous across delay: servants' acts are fully observed while judgment is deliberately held to an appointed term.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a meteorological transport chain onto revelation; it remains anchored in the focus's directed imparting and written message, and the context supplies sending, driving, dead ground, revivification, and rising. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for communicative efficacy, not as a lexical equation between Book and rain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus words 2 and 5 describe something directed to the addressee from the Book, allowing the delivered message to be viewed as a carried medium.

activation_trace.role: Directed hidden imparting supplies the delivery process to which the material analogy attaches.
The written message supplies the content carried through that process.
Dispatch and movement outward supply the first stage of the transport chain.
Driving a carried body toward a destination supplies directed delivery to a recipient.
Lifeless land supplies the initially unreceptive substrate reached by the delivery.
Earth revived through water and growth supplies the changed state caused by reception.
Rising after death supplies the maximal outcome toward which the delivery analogy points.

changed_reading.before: Revelation is transfer of information to a recipient.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, revelation is a routed, life-bearing delivery whose truth becomes legible in the recipient's transition from inertness to responsive life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it activates account, due, charity, and immediate-settlement senses inside a theological sentence; it remains anchored in the focus roots for Book, truth, confirmation, and hand, while 35:29-30 supplies expenditure, non-failing trade, and full payment. Downstream prose should mark it as an economic-juridical analogy, not translate the focus participle as an alms collector.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus words 5, 7, 8, and 11 can jointly support a register, a valid claim, financial truthfulness, and hand-to-hand settlement.

activation_trace.role: A binding recorded determination supplies the account or ledger frame.
A claim held by its owner supplies what the ledger recognizes as due.
Giving wealth as a truthful due supplies a distant but anchored financial activation of confirmation.
Immediate hand-to-hand exchange supplies settlement rather than indefinite credit.
Wealth leaving possession supplies the debit or expenditure enacted by the readers.
Trade seeking return supplies the explicit economic frame around engagement with the Book.
Market stagnation ending in loss supplies the failure explicitly denied of this trade.
Full completion without shortfall supplies final settlement of what is due.

changed_reading.before: The Book verifies prior information in an abstract epistemic relation.
changed_reading.after: As a contained economic analogy, the Book is a binding account that recognizes valid claims, records truthful expenditure, and carries the promised exchange through to full settlement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines rare material branches for joining, tight construction, and stitched edges with cosmic holding; it remains anchored in four focus lexemes and is activated by 35:41's holding-versus-dislocation contrast. Downstream prose should call it a tactile coherence model, never a lexical translation or a claim that the verse literally describes cosmological fabric.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus words 5, 7, 10, and 16 admit material images of joining, tight construction, connective interval, and sewn edges.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another supplies the Book as an assembled coherence.
Tight construction in cloth or speech supplies truth as structural soundness.
A connector maintained between sides supplies the relational joint.
Stitching two pieces along a substantial edge supplies the outlier's tactile joining image.
Holding and restraining supplies the force that preserves an assembled order.
Displacement from place or state supplies the disintegration that holding prevents.

changed_reading.before: Truth is only correct semantic content.
changed_reading.after: As a tightly contained material model, the truth-confirming Book is an assembled joint whose coherent relations hold disparate witnesses together against displacement.

strongest_changes: The close functions as an expert-source credential and as correction of deceptive appearance, not merely as a generic title pair.
Confirmation becomes performative: recited word, fitting work, expenditure, and completed payment form an enactment chain.
The focus is a hinge from revelation to inherited, morally mixed stewardship among the servants named on both sides of the hinge.
Truth and confirmation remain valid without compelling uptake; arrival can produce discernment or increased aversion.
The final servants-and-sight echo recasts divine seeing as continuous oversight compatible with deliberate delay.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly turns apparently static nouns into processes: Book becomes register, evidence, recited practice, and inheritance; confirmation becomes fulfillment; sight becomes correction and patient oversight. It also keeps retrospective textual confirmation, prospective promise, and visible historical corroboration simultaneously live.
remaining_uncertainties: The front-facing idiom does not decide whether prospective fulfillment genuinely belongs to its referent or is only a contextual resonance.
The register reading of Book depends on semantic carryback from 35:11 and may remain distinct from scripture in the focus.
The unequal-waters analogy supports confirmation without identity, but its transfer from creation to textual media is exploratory.
The subject-object relation of the raising verb in 35:10 leaves several action-word causal directions grammatically live.
The three material outliers are mechanistically anchored but should never displace the stronger communicative, evidentiary, and stewardship readings.
